description:
FILED s471 (Fable, 2026-09-06), probed on main 9ee95f2: `PCL_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/x PCL_NO_CORE=1 ./pcl -e 'use Text::ParseWords qw(shellwords); print scalar(shellwords("a b c"))'` wrote proto/Text_ParseWords-*.json under /tmp/x and the module .lisp under ~/.pcl-cache (117 -> 118 files).  Cause: cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~17775 `(defparameter *pcl-cache-dir* (merge-pathnames ".pcl-cache/" (user-homedir-pathname)))` -- an initform, evaluated when the runtime loads.  Consequences: (1) PCL_CACHE_DIR is a lie for modules; (2) a SAVED CORE bakes the BUILDER's home in, so a system-wide pcl.core built by root sends every user's module cache to /root/.pcl-cache (unwritable -> every module re-transpiled every run, or a die); (3) *p-xs-cache-dir* NIL derives from it lazily, so xs/ follows.

FIX: compute the directory at process START -- an sb-ext:*init-hooks* entry (runs after a core starts) that sets *pcl-cache-dir* from PCL_CACHE_DIR or the CURRENT user's home; every cache path derives from it at CALL time.  Guard: Pl/t/module-fasl-cache-01.t row: PCL_CACHE_DIR=<tmpdir> -> the module .lisp and .fasl appear under it and NOT under ~/.pcl-cache; plus a row through a SAVED core (tools/prove-core's temp core) so the init-hook path is the one tested.

Owner: #1300 (BY).  Blocks the installed-mode half of #1302.
=== DONE (s470by) ===

Fixed as item A of #1300.  %p-default-cache-dir + an sb-ext:*init-hooks* entry, so
PCL_CACHE_DIR is read at PROCESS START and every cache path derives from it at
call time; the defparameter initform is gone.  The three Perl-side readings
(pcl:63, PCLSbcl::core_cache_dir, Pl::ProtoCache::cache_dir) became one,
PCLPaths::cache_root, with cache_root_source telling env from default.

PROBE, before and after: PCL_CACHE_DIR=<tmp> pcl -e 'use Text::ParseWords ...'
put proto/ under the tmpdir and the module .lisp under ~/.pcl-cache (530 -> 533
files) BEFORE; AFTER, ~/.pcl-cache is unchanged and both modules/ and proto/ are
under the tmpdir.  And the shape no local rehearsal reproduces, the one an
INSTALLED core has: a core BUILT with PCL_CACHE_DIR=A and RUN with =B writes into
B.  Guard rows: Pl/t/module-fasl-cache-01.t 44-47 + 49 (they FAIL on a cd34df72
extraction), including a row through a SAVED core so the init-hook path is the
tested one.

Bars with #1300: gate 216 files / 7517 rows, Result FAIL = only the 13 pclxs xs rows, sweep TOTAL 18647 (+0) GATE clean, corpus-diff
IDENTICAL over 111.
subject: BUG: the runtime ignores PCL_CACHE_DIR for the MODULE cache -- *pcl-cache-dir* is a defparameter initform (evaluated at LOAD = core-build time, from the builder's HOME); proto/, core/ and --clear-cache honour the variable, the README says it moves the cache
